dct_description_sm: "Entered according to Act of Congress in the Office of the Clerk of the Supreme Court of the District of Columbia in the year 1876."

Also covers Rosslyn (Va.). Also shows block numbers, water and sewer lines, streetlights, major buildings, and streetcar lines. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the Office of the Clerk of the Supreme Court of the District of Columbia in the year 1876." Originally printed on 6 sheets. Includes notes, insets of D.C. avenues and Alexandria, population table, and D.C. commissioners' names. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC sheets assembled to 1 sheet, sectioned to 6 sheets, darkened, cracked, missing edge and internal sections, and mounted on cloth backing. DCP
